Definition: from G2482; Italic, i.e. belonging to Italia:--Italian.
BiblicalUsage: Italian is the word for the band Cornelius commanded, the cohort from Italy. In Acts 10:1 there is a man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band, a devout man who feared God with all his house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Italian band is the door the gospel walked through: a Roman soldier who prayed, and an angel who answered.
